description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Mox Amber.
Yomiji triggers, returning Mox Amber from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
When Mox Amber enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana of any color among legendary creatures or planeswalkers you control.
Repeat.
